business_problem: As an early adopter of Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 and Copilot for Sales, PA Consulting treated itself as “customer zero,” using the lessons it learned to support clients on their own AI journeys. Employees who used Microsoft Copilot saw immediate time-savings of three hours per week on average.
solution_summary: As an early adopter of Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365 and Copilot for Sales, PA Consulting treated itself as “customer zero,” using the lessons it learned to support clients on their own AI journeys. Employees who used Microsoft Copilot saw immediate time-savings of three hours per week on average. But more importantly, PA Consulting wanted to know how that time could be repurposed. PA has since transformed its sales operations, making them more streamlined and unified—meaning that its people can invest more time on the activities that have the biggest impact for clients, and maximize the strategic value they provide. Early Copilot usage could save 300 employees 45,000+ hours annually PA’s journey began in September 2023 when 300 people were given access to Copilot in Microsoft 365 and Copilot for Sales as part of Microsoft’s Early Access Program.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Sales
solution_components.role: Surfaces customer context and AI assistance inside seller workflows to reduce manual sales work.

solution_components.role: Supports sellers with opportunity management, customer context, and AI-assisted sales workflows.

solution_components.role: Connects users, experts, or frontline staff for collaboration, communication, and workflow execution.
